actions.name: Spin Up
actions.description: The mech gains a swim speed equal to its base frame speed for 10 rounds.

actions.name: Turbo Spin
actions.description: The mech's swim speed increases to its highest speed for one round, and it can make a charge as a standard action without the normal penalties while swimming.

description.value:
@PPAbility[cost:1]{Spin Up} The mech gains a swim speed equal to its base frame speed for 10 rounds.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Turbo Spin} The mech's swim speed increases to its highest speed for one round, and it can make a charge as a standard action without the normal penalties while swimming.

Auxiliary Slots: 1.
